title: Sr. Faculty for NEET - Sri Chaitanya
jobDescription:
The candidate must be a Graduate / Postgraduate with subject specialization and adequate experience of teaching. Candidates opting for Chemistry Faculty must also specify Organic / Inorganic / Physical / All as their area of expertise. Role Shall be responsible for effectively delivering the curriculum as per the syllabus for NEET-UG, AIIMS, BITSAT, MT-CET, 12th Boards, Olympiads, KVPY, NTSE etc. Shall be responsible for the overall performance & improvement of each student. Must participate in the management & coordination of activities of the specific subject.

ROLE:
Professor Industry : Education / Training Functional Area : Teaching & Training Employment Type : Full Time, Permanent

EDUCATION:
Graduate/PG/Doctorate/Ph D in Advanced Sciences
